about_the_game:
In the center of a dark forest, amidst the cold mists, stands an ancient tree - the heart of an ancient curse. You are one of the few groups that decided to unravel the mystery of the forest and finish the ritual that others began many years ago.

The Hallowed Echo is a cooperative survival horror for 1-4 players that immerses you in a gloomy atmosphere of hunting, stealth and investigation of mysterious anomalies. Build a camp, find weapons, food and tools, fight hunger and cold, and try not to attract the attention of... him.

Key features:

🧠 Atmospheric Survival Horror

Dynamic shadows, flashlight, sounds that make you look around.

Hunger, thirst, fatigue and cold - everything works against you.

👥 Co-op up to 4 players

It's easier to survive together... but the monster hears everyone.

Transport each other on a boat, share resources, heal your comrades.

🔫 Diverse interaction

Boat control, fire lighting, shotgun shooting, map reading, compass, item selection.

Manual reload, ADS, 4-slot inventory.

👹 Single boss enemy

You can't kill him directly. Only weaken and perform a ritual.

🌲 Open forest with points of interest

Abandoned huts, ritual areas, hiding places, graves, secret symbols.

Dynamic compass and mini-map markers depending on progress.

🔥 Main objective

Destroy three "cocoons" near the tree.

Set fire to the tree.

Survive until it burns down.

short_description: Cooperative survival horror. Four friends find themselves in a forest where an ancient ritual has awakened something terrifying. Your goal is to destroy the root of evil by burning a cursed tree and survive until morning. Explore, hunt, hide. Alone is scary. Together is even worse.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Indonesian
